luck_action_bindings.description: Compiled luck-action binding catalog. One entry per bound action offer: the engine-exact pre-roll check the platform passes back unchanged, the preserved authored declaration, the swap recipes with their stable slot bindings and the clocks that must stay non-terminal, the leave-door remedy entries and the all-in benefit pairs. Normalised from the Pack author block; runtime resolves entries by offer_ref only and never reads an author path.

attempt_clock.description: band 外的一次提交推进：最终提交后按 delta 移动该公开时钟，delta 保留正负方向，threshold_event 在达到 threshold_value 时关闭对应段；null 表示本动作没有 band 外时钟推进。

document_sha256.description: Canonical digest of the catalog without this field.

offline_public_catalog.description: 冻结的可选公开离线目录；1.0.0 无公开计数，1.1.0 为 deadline 轨道带 clock_delta 与公开时钟。

stages.description: 阶段 step 必须是从 1 开始的连续升序；return_to_table 为 true 的阶段不会自动推进，只在 deferred 中报告一次。

clock_delta.description: 本阶段推进该 deadline 轨道公开时钟的步数；非 deadline 轨道与 return_to_table 阶段必须为 0。

static_visual_style.description: 可选作者画风声明：公开的 style_ref、instruction 与 #RRGGBB 色板；缺声明时字段缺席，平台按不支持的画风处理。
